g.text: Settings | Global preferences, appearance, storage, and app behavior | Local
State: Draft — save with s | Settings owns launch and web display defaults.
Settings owns launch visual defaults. Open the Theme category for full theme editing and deeper
Motion is suppressed by Reduce motion. Expressions still change.
Automatic: 3:13 plus five, bounded to 29–39 cells. Custom: preferred 24–48 cells; it may shrink
temporarily to keep 40 content cells. Adaptive readers may collapse panes. In ordinary views below 64
columns, use ‹ Library (< Library in ASCII) to return to the rail.
Esc, s save category | Esc, r revert category | Esc, t preview appearance | F1 help · F6 next pane · Ctrl+P palette · Ctrl+Q quit
